name: shop-swift
description: Shop Swift — an F1-themed multi-vendor e-commerce platform (MERN + TypeScript)

scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -n SHARED,SERVER,CLIENT -c yellow,blue,magenta "npm run watch -w shared" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
